description:
A place name to candidates with coordinates and the IANA zone, for a birthplace field. Matches a prefix, ignores case, accents and punctuation (`krakow` finds Kraków, `St. Petersburg` finds Saint Petersburg), and knows the names GeoNames carries in our 21 languages and older ones such as Kiev. Ranked by population, an exact name counting ten times its size, so an ambiguous name such as Springfield lists every town largest first; `q=Springfield, Illinois` or `Springfield, MA` narrows by region or country after the comma.

[Group: Astro-Geography]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/geo/search]
[Required: q]
[Cost: 5 credits (Tier ½)]

country.description: Restrict to these ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, comma separated, up to 20.

lang.description: Language for `name`, `admin1` and `country`. Where GeoNames has no name in it, the GeoNames name stays. Matching always covers every language.

q.description: Place name or its beginning, in any of our languages and scripts. Case, accents and punctuation are ignored. Text after the first comma narrows by region or country instead: `Springfield, Illinois`, `Springfield, MA`, `Paris, US`.

name: astroway_geo_search
title: Place search
